title: The 4 Best Mini Fridges Under $150
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for mini fridges under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini fridges under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea WHS-160RB1 4.4 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.4 cu ft capacity, the largest in this roundup, Typically $140 to $170, 42 dB rated noise level.
strengths: 42 dB rating makes it the quietest fridge in this price tier
Adjustable legs and a reversible door add real placement flexibility
limitations: Still no true freezer, chiller compartment only
33.86-inch height won't fit under most desks
Some owners report occasional compressor hum after a year of use
features: 4.4 cu ft capacity, the largest in this roundup
Small chiller compartment, not a true freezer

products.name: Galanz GLR31TBEER 3.1 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer, Typically $150 to $190, sometimes just above this budget tier, True dual-door design with an actual freezer.
strengths: Only model in this roundup with a genuine separate freezer for ice and frozen food
Retro styling stands out from typical black or white compact fridges
Under-42 dB compressor keeps it quiet despite the added freezer hardware
limitations: Some owners report inconsistent cooling after a couple years of daily use
Plastic interior parts feel less sturdy than metal shelving on pricier fridges
features: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer
Typically $150 to $190, sometimes just above this budget tier
True dual-door design with an actual freezer

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK25V 2.5 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5 cu ft single-door capacity, Typically $120 to $150, ENERGY STAR certified, about 212 kWh/year.
strengths: ENERGY STAR certification keeps ongoing running cost among the lowest here
Glass shelves and a proper door bin feel more finished than budget-tier fridges
limitations: 2.5 cu ft is smaller than the Midea's 4.4 cu ft at a similar price
Small top freezer barely holds an ice tray
features: Small freezer compartment with ice tray

products.name: Midea WHS-65LB1 1.6 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
limitations: Can over-chill items near the top
